h1.en: Power Cell Electric 30 Concrete Pump Prints: 30 kW beside the Clutch article
h1.zh: 电动30型混凝土泵的动力格子印了什么：对照「離合器」时，30 kW仍在原页

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 30 Concrete Pump power text in Xingtai as: Motor Power is 30 kW. An electric motor entry is kilowatts on a motor. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clutch.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动30型混凝土泵的动力文字写成：电机功率是30 kW。画面「Induction motor」的主体是Rotterdam Ahoy Europort 2011 (14)。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clutch。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clutch. The picture shows Clutchdisc. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 30 Concrete Pump power text in Xingtai as: Motor Power is 30 kW. The frame “Induction motor” shows Rotterdam Ahoy Europort 2011 (14). Electric drive and diesel drive are different supplies. Max. Outlet Pressure remains 20 MPa. Hopper capacity is 0.3 m³. Those entries, when shown, stay in their own columns.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clutch。画面是Clutchdisc。河北品锦机械在邢台把电动30型混凝土泵的动力文字写成：电机功率是30 kW。河北品锦机械不从这一帧里提取千瓦或发动机代号。

body.en: An electric motor entry is kilowatts on a motor. It does not change this power entry, and a diesel code is not copied onto an electric row. Use the label on this sheet, not the neighbouring model's label. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not lift kilowatts or an engine code out of that frame. Fine Stone Pumping (H / V) 60 m / 180 m. A larger motor entry is not a longer pipeline.
body.zh: 画面「Induction motor」的主体是Rotterdam Ahoy Europort 2011 (14)。细石输送（水平/垂直） 60 m / 180 m。

body.en: A diesel entry names the engine line that is actually shown. Motor Power is 30 kW. Output Capacity remains 12–15 m³/h. If this row has no voltage entry, none is invented. Main-unit weight is 1200 kg.
body.zh: 它不改这一格动力，也不会把柴油机代号抄到电动行上。

question.en: What power text does Electric 30 Concrete Pump list?
question.zh: 电动30型混凝土泵的动力文字是什么？

answer.en: Motor Power is 30 kW. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clutch.
answer.zh: 电机功率是30 kW。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clutch画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Can a diesel code be moved onto this row?
question.zh: 可以把柴油机代号挪到这一行吗？

answer.en: Only if this row already lists it. Otherwise the entry stays as written. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clutch.
answer.zh: 只有这一行已经标出了才能算。否则格子保持原样。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clutch画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: What are output and pressure on this sheet?
question.zh: 这一页的输送量和压力是多少？

answer.en: Output Capacity is 12–15 m³/h. Max. Outlet Pressure is 20 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clutch.
answer.zh: 理论输送量是12–15 m³/h。最大出口压力是20 MPa。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clutch画面里印出的数字。
